resolutions.control: Task and cluster verifiers now derive results from live leases, commits, tests, repository state, integration evidence, and independent review; forged completion tests reject both paths.
Full recorded lifecycle, isolated worktree, real rebase/fast-forward merge, atomic-commit check, post-rebase verification, injected integration failure, and Git revert are executable.
Filesystem path/symlink confinement and immutable collision checks are enforced; same-byte writes are idempotent and changed bytes fail for filesystem, fake, and S3 stores.
Transactions use scoped connections/savepoints; readiness requires a valid migration ledger and all required tables. Live rollback and empty-schema tests pass.
Scanners cover executable repository roots and reject prohibited aliases, skipped/todo tests, trivial assertions, suppressions, placeholders, and empty catches; controlled mutations pass.
Compiler emits 84 bounded contracts with exact write/allowed sets, real test mappings, unique acceptance ownership, five exclusive migration owners, and non-recursive verification.
Dashboard server load fetches API readiness; browser E2E proves API-backed unavailable labeling and synthetic disclaimer.
API selects configured filesystem/S3 store, S3 fields validate, Compose provisions the bucket, and live MinIO tests pass.
Production configuration requires explicit database, origin, MCP secret, and selected object-store settings and rejects development defaults.
All degraded/fake capability results carry the typed PRODUCTION or SYNTHETIC_SHADOW mode; bootstrap implementations remain synthetic.
Hermetic and live-service skeletons cover durable rows/artifacts, evidence, as-of replay, idempotency, retry, maturity, trace continuity, crash/resume, quota/model/storage/late-data scenarios.
Content-addressed semantic artifact freezes normative inventories without live calls; compilation is locked, byte-deterministic, and rejects unexpected output drift.
CI invokes real build/static/unit/integration/system/service/browser/spec/mutation/harness/lifecycle/scanner/migration commands and explicit forgery negatives.

A reviewed initial main baseline is created from the repository root and the verified bootstrap descendant is merged. Missing prompt semantics were not reconstructed; direct PRD/manifest verification removes release ambiguity. Owner archival remains external.
MCP requires allowed Origin and optional production-required bearer auth, and bounds bytes, protocol, client IDs, tracked clients, rate, concurrency, execution time, and transport lifetime.
Readiness catches rejection and timeout as not-ready; signal handlers await server and database shutdown and exit deterministically.
Ineffective outcome helper was made semantic, bootstrap behavior is exercised, and future interfaces cannot claim production availability.
